description: This file defines an administrative controller class for managing comments within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for listing comments, approving comments, marking comments as spam, and deleting comments, with various filtering options and pagination support.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for managing comments in the admin panel, including listing, approving, marking spam, and deleting comments.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for managing comments in the admin panel, including listing, approving, marking spam, deleting, and rating comments.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point displaying the comment management page with filtering options. Sets up the page title, breadcrumbs, and loads the comment list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch a paginated list of comments based on filtering parameters, and renders the comment list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves comments from the model based on filter parameters such as keyword, article, customer, status, date range, and page number. Returns HTML for the comment list table.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to approve selected comments, changing their status to approved.

methods.name: spam
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to mark selected comments as spam.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to delete selected comments.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Handles comment rating refresh, including pagination and displaying statistical ratings.
